about: Drummond/North Elmsley is a township in Lanark County, Ontario, wrapping around the separate Town of Perth and toward Smiths Falls—not those towns, and not Drummondville, Quebec. Rideau and Mississippi lake country, hamlets such as Port Elmsley and Innisville, and farmland define the township. About 8,000 people live in Drummond/North Elmsley.
